title: ResComEmb: Effective and Efficient Multimodal Embedding via Residual Homogeneity Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.37225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for universal multimodal representation learning. However, existing methods either compress each input into a single vector, limiting fine-grained expressiveness, or retain long sequences of visual-token vectors, incurring substantial storage and interaction costs. To resolve this trade-off, we propose ResComEmb, a trainable framework for effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding. ResComEmb first encodes each input at native dynamic resolution into ordered global, intermediate, and fine-grained views. After MLLM contextualization and embedding projection, a trainable Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) module reduces within-granularity redundancy and cross-granularity repetition under explicit visual token budgets. Then, ResComEmb introduces a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism for robust query-document scori

translated_title: ResComEmb：通过残差同质性压缩实现高效且有效的多模态嵌入
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用多模态表示学习中展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法要么将每个输入压缩为单个向量，限制了细粒度的表达能力；要么保留长序列的视觉token向量，带来巨大的存储和交互成本。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了ResComEmb，一个用于有效且高效地构建通用多向量多模态嵌入的可训练框架。ResComEmb首先以原生动态分辨率将每个输入编码为有序的全局、中间和细粒度视图。在经过MLLM上下文建模和嵌入投影后，可训练的残差同质性压缩（RHC）模块在显式视觉token预算约束下，减少粒度内冗余和跨粒度重复。随后，ResComEmb引入了一种长度自适应的双向后期交互匹配机制，以实现鲁棒的查询-文档评分。
tldr: ResComEmb提出可训练框架，通过残差同质性压缩模块在显式视觉token预算下消除粒度内冗余与跨粒度重复，并结合长度自适应的双向后期交互匹配机制，实现了兼顾效果与效率的通用多向量多模态嵌入。
en_tdlr: ResComEmb proposes a trainable framework that combines Residual Homogeneity Compression and a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism to achieve effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding under explicit visual token budgets.
